name: bough
notes: New terminal-first Go coding agent. The model writes executable JavaScript programs that can batch and branch across patches, shell commands, subagents, background jobs, and MCP tools. Ships as one binary with TUI, headless JSON mode, serve/web control room, plugin-based providers/loops/tools, append-only session history, skills/hooks, and macOS/Linux support for x86-64 and arm64.

name: Codewhale
notes: New current terminal-first Rust coding agent with official macOS/Linux release installer. Supports hosted and local models through Ollama, vLLM, and SGLang; interactive TUI and codewhale exec headless mode; session persistence, durable goals, permissions, agent teams, MCP, hooks, skills, local web client, and optional computer-use tooling.
